messages.text: What is going on with the Harmattan Bank go-live? Can we invoice the final stage yet?

Not yet. The go-live report was sent to the client at 10:02, but the delivery result is unknown, so the factory is checking for a receipt before anything is resent. The client has not signed go-live acceptance, and milestone 3 is not marked complete. Stage 3 can be invoiced after the PM records that milestone.
